notes: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first to validate latency/cost tradeoffs for chat-driven support agent and document search. Product team (cto, head of platform) wants a predictable unit cost before committing to Dedicated. Seamless migration path and same API across hosted->dedicated is a must. Primary concerns: SSO integration, audit logs retention 1 year, and EU data residency for subset of customers. Quoted: "we need predictable per-customer cost and the ability to pin a model version for audits". Trial has been primarily test traffic from sandbox customers and internal QA - not production traffic yet.
capacity_sizing_notes: Hosted API trial summary (30d): average QPS = 6.8, median concurrency = 18, 95th percentile QPS bursts up to 48. Typical request mix: 70% embeddings (short vectors, ~512 tokens total per call), 20% chat/support-agent flows (prompt 60 tokens -> completion 180 tokens), 10% long summarization jobs (input 2k tokens -> completion 800 tokens). Observed token mix (input+output): 70% short <1k tokens, 25% mid 1k-3k, 5% long >3k. Average tokens per request ~820. Monthly trial projections scaled to prod (x10 growth): expected sustained QPS ~68, peak burst QPS ~480, baseline concurrency target ~200, peak concurrency ~800 during promotional spikes. Dedicated sizing ask: want sustained latency <150ms tail for chat flows and cost target <$0.0006 per token effective. SE recommendation (initial): Start Dedicated with a 4-GPU pool (A100-80GB equiv) configured with batching + KV cache for chat routes; estimated baseline capacity ~75-100 QPS for chat+embeddings with current token mix; add 2x burst nodes (same GPU type) for predictable spikes to ~400-500 QPS; enable prefix caching for doc-search and reranking to reduce tokens and increase throughput; quantization recommendation: int8 for embedding servers, nbit-quant for chat models to hit cost targets. Cost sensitivity: break-even vs Hosted API within 6-9 months at projected usage. Rough monthly token forecast (prod scale): tokens/month ~1.2B (current x10 scenario) -> avg token/sec ~463; requests/month ~1.5M -> avg QPS ~0.6*requests/sec skewed by long jobs. Sizing caveat: exact GPU count depends on model family (Llama2-70B vs 13B variants) and sequence length distribution. POC milestones: dedicated sizing calc, pilot 2-week Dedicated run with production routing, observe 99th latency and token cost, sign committed capacity.
